title: Direction of a translated subspace
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $H$ be a linear subspace of $\mathbb F_2^n$, and let $a\in\mathbb F_2^n$. The direction subspace of the affine subspace $a+H$ is $H$.
hypotheses_covered: $H$ is a linear subspace of $\mathbb F_2^n$
